INTRODUCTION

This manual presents all the operations carried out in a workshop after the disassembly of the passen-
ger seats of the EMB-120 "BRASILIA" aircraft. It allows a technician not acquainted with the equipment
to restore it to its operational conditions.

This manual contains the component description and operation, detailed instructions for disassembling,
checking, repairing and reassembling the component, and an illustrated parts list.

All the procedures described in this manual have been performed by the manufacturer prior to its release
to the users.

The methods presented herein, especially those concerning repairs, must not be modified or extended
to other cases without prior authorization granted by the aviation authorities and the manufacturer.

DESCRIPTION AND OPERATION
1. General
The passenger seats are arranged into two rows in the aircraft, one comprising single seats and
another comprising double seats. In some configurations, the last row may also comprise triple
seats.
2. Description
A. The Single Passenger Seat (Figure 1) configurations listed below may be found on the "EMB-
120" Brasilia:
(1) First row single passenger seat with plug-in type snack table.
(2) Complete Single Passenger Seat with two armrests and snack folding table.
(3) Single Passenger Seat without armrest on the wall side (emergency exit position).
(4) Single Passenger Seat without snack folding table (last row).
(5) Single Passenger Seat with longer armrest, without snack folding table, to fit the triple pas-
senger seat row.
B. The Double Passenger Seat (Figure 2) may be found in the following configurations:
(1) First row Double Passenger Seat with plug-in type snack table.

G. The backrest structure consists of a rigid composite structure attached to the seat structure and
molded foam cushion is glued to this structure, then covered with fitted upholstery, which, in turn,
is secured with Velcro fastener.

H. The seat bottom cushion is made of molded foam and is covered by the upholstery which is
secured with Velcro fastener.

J. The snack folding table is installed to the back face of the backrest. The snack folding table oper-
ation, when it is extended, is completely independent of the backrest.

K. The plug-in type snack table fits into the armrests.

L. The magazine holder is fitted in the back face of the seat.

M. In the bottom of the each seat place there is a life jacket stowage assembly.
